# Data Source Catalogue

## 1. Apple Health
Apple Health categorizes its data primarily into `HKQuantityType` (numerical values) and `HKCategoryType` (small set of possible values, like sleep stages).

**Cardiovascular and Vital Signs:**

*   **Heart Rate:** `heartRate`, `restingHeartRate`, `walkingHeartRateAverage`.
*   **Heart Rate Variability (HRV):** Measured as the standard deviation of heartbeat intervals (`heartRateVariabilitySDNN`).
*   **Blood Pressure:** Captures both `bloodPressureSystolic` and `bloodPressureDiastolic`.
*   **Respiration & Oxygen:** `respiratoryRate`, `oxygenSaturation`, and `forcedVitalCapacity`.
*   **Electrocardiogram:** `ElectrocardiogramType` for ECG data.
*   **Body Temperature:** `bodyTemperature` and `basalBodyTemperature`.

**Activity and Mobility Metrics:**

*   **Movement:** `stepCount`, `distanceWalkingRunning`, `distanceCycling`, and `distanceWheelchair`.
*   **Energy:** `basalEnergyBurned` (resting) and `activeEnergyBurned`.
*   **Advanced Gait Metrics:** `walkingSpeed`, `walkingStepLength`, `walkingAsymmetryPercentage`, and `appleWalkingSteadiness`.

**Clinical and Wellness Data:**

*   **Body Measurements:** `bodyMassIndex` (BMI), `bodyFatPercentage`, `leanBodyMass`, and `waistCircumference`.
*   **Sleep:** `sleepAnalysis` (category sample for sleep information).
*   **Blood & Symptoms:** `bloodGlucose`, `bloodAlcoholContent`, and `electrodermalActivity` (sweat gland activity).

## 2. Samsung Health
Samsung Health explicitly tracks user-set goals as distinct, aggregatable data types.

**Physiological and Sleep Metrics:**

*   **Cardiovascular:** Heart rate (supports aggregation and read changes), Blood pressure, and Irregular heart rhythm notifications.
*   **Blood & Oxygen:** Blood glucose and Blood oxygen.
*   **Sleep Data:** Tracks overall Sleep, Sleep apnea, and allows setting a "Sleep goal".
*   **Temperature & Composition:** Skin temperature, Body temperature, and Body composition.

**Activity & Lifestyle:**

*   **Activity Tracking:** Exercise, Exercise location, and Floors climbed.
*   **Energy & Nutrition:** Energy score, Active calories burned goal, Active time goal, Nutrition logs, and Nutrition goals.

## 3. Google Health
Google specifically standardizes exercise distances (e.g. `elevationGainMillimeters`) in millimeters to maintain high precision across all developers, regardless of imperial or metric systems.

**Cardiovascular & Vitals:**

*   **Heart Metrics:** Heart Rate, Resting Heart Rate, Daily Heart Rate Variability, Heart Rate Zones, and Electrocardiogram (ECG).
*   **Respiratory & Oxygen:** Oxygen Saturation, Daily Respiratory Rate, and Core Body Temperature.

**Activity & Body Metrics:**

*   **Energy & Workouts:** Active Energy Burned, Active Minutes, VO2 Max, Run VO2 Max, Steps, Distance, and Swim Lengths Data.
*   **Body & Nutrition:** Weight, Height, Body Fat, Hydration Log, Food logs, and Nutrition Log.
*   **Sleep:** Sleep sessions and Respiratory Rate Sleep Summary.

**Summary Table:**

## 4. Garmin
Garmin uniquely separates its data streams into All-Day Metrics (via the Health API/Companion SDK) and Real-Time Streaming Metrics (via the Standard/Companion SDKs).

**All-Day Metrics (Historic/Daily Aggregations):**

*   **Energy & Stress:** Body Battery, Stress Levels, Calories, and Intensity Minutes.
*   **Vitals:** Heart Rate, Pulse Ox, Respiration Rate, and Index Scale Biometrics.
*   **Activity & Sleep:** Steps, Distance, Floors Climbed, Fitness Activity Details, Sleep, Advanced Sleep Data, and Health Snapshot.

**Real-Time Streaming & Customizable Logging:**

*   **High-Resolution Physiological Data:** Enhanced Beat-To-Beat Intervals (crucial for accurate real-time HRV calculations), Heart Rate, Pulse Ox, and Respiration Rate.
*   **Raw Kinematics:** Accelerometer (including sums of axis crossings), Gyroscope, and Actigraphy.
*   **Device Status:** Device Battery Percentage and Unique Device ID.

# Data Dictionary

Below is a Data Dictionary mapping the different brand-specific inputs into standardized variables for each category.

### 1. Cardiovascular & Vitals

| Ikarians Standard Variable | Data Type | Unit | Source Brand Mappings | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `heart_rate` | Numeric | bpm | Apple (Heart Rate), Samsung (Heart rate), Google (Heart Rate), Garmin (Heart Rate) | Continuous heart rate measurement. |
| `resting_heart_rate` | Numeric | bpm | Apple (Resting Heart Rate), Google (Daily Resting Heart Rate) | Baseline heart rate measured during rest. |
| `heart_rate_variability` | Numeric | ms | Apple (Heart Rate Variability), Google (Heart Rate Variability) | Variation in time intervals between heartbeats. |
| `blood_pressure` | Numeric | mmHg | Apple (Blood Pressure), Samsung (Blood pressure) | Captures systolic and diastolic measurements. |
| `ecg_signal` | Categorical | N/A | Apple (Electrocardiograms), Google (Electrocardiogram) | Electrocardiogram tracking and irregular rhythm notifications. |

### 2. Respiration & Oxygen

| Ikarians Standard Variable | Data Type | Unit | Source Brand Mappings | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `respiratory_rate` | Numeric | brpm | Apple (Respiratory Rate), Google (Daily Respiratory Rate), Garmin (Respiration) | Breaths per minute. |
| `blood_oxygen` | Numeric | % | Apple (Blood Oxygen), Samsung (Blood oxygen), Google (Oxygen Saturation), Garmin (Pulse Ox) | Peripheral oxygen saturation levels (SpO2). |

### 3. Temperature

| Ikarians Standard Variable | Data Type | Unit | Source Brand Mappings | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `core_body_temperature` | Numeric | °C/°F | Apple (Body Temperature), Samsung (Body temperature), Google (Core Body Temperature) | Estimated core physiological temperature. |

### 4. Activity & Mobility

| Ikarians Standard Variable | Data Type | Unit | Source Brand Mappings | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `daily_steps` | Numeric | Count | Apple (Steps), Google (Steps), Garmin (Steps) | Total step count over a specified interval. |
| `active_energy_burned` | Numeric | kcal | Apple (Active Energy), Google (Active Energy Burned), Garmin (Calories) | Caloric expenditure during movement. |
| `distance_traveled` | Numeric | meters | Apple (Walking + Running Distance), Google (Distance) | Standardized to millimeters by Google and tracked generally by Apple. |
| `floors_climbed` | Numeric | Count | Samsung (Floors climbed), Garmin (Floors Climbed) | Vertical movement tracking. |
| `advanced_gait_metrics` | Numeric | m/s, % | Apple (Walking Speed, Walking Asymmetry) | Speed, step length, and movement symmetry. |

### 5. Sleep & Recovery

| Ikarians Standard Variable | Data Type | Unit | Source Brand Mappings | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `sleep_tracking` | Categorical / Numeric | Minutes | Apple (Sleep), Samsung (Sleep), Google (Sleep), Garmin (Sleep) | Sleep duration and stage analysis. |
| `sleep_apnea_flag` | Boolean | True/False | Samsung (Sleep apnea) | Specific detection of sleep apnea events. |
| `device_energy_score` | Numeric | 0-100 | Samsung (Energy score), Garmin (Body Battery) | Device-specific proprietary recovery/energy algorithms. |
| `device_stress_score` | Numeric | 0-100 | Garmin (Stress) | Derived stress calculations based on HRV and activity. |

### 6. Body Composition & Clinical Markers

| Ikarians Standard Variable | Data Type | Unit | Source Brand Mappings | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `blood_glucose` | Numeric | mg/dL | Apple (Blood Glucose), Samsung (Blood glucose) | Endogenous blood sugar tracking. |
| `body_fat_percentage` | Numeric | % | Apple (Body Fat Percentage), Google (Body Fat), Samsung/Garmin (Body Composition) | Estimated percentage of adipose tissue. |
| `weight_and_bmi` | Numeric | kg/index | Apple (BMI, Lean Body Mass), Google (Weight, Height) | Body mass and structural measurements. |
| `nutrition_log` | String/JSON | N/A | Samsung (Nutrition), Google (Nutrition Log) | Input detailing dietary and hydration entries. |
